name: Seattle Road Safety — curated collision hotspot tables, 2019–2025
description: Course data product integrating City of Seattle collision, street and traffic-study extracts. Produces quality-controlled recorded collision counts by road segment or intersection and year, plus a validated record-level file. Counts are not traffic-exposure-adjusted risk: only 790 of 16,569 segment-year groups (4.77%) have an eligible same-year traffic study.
conditionsOfAccess: Not publicly deposited; shared with the examiner as a course package. The three source datasets are publicly available at the URLs in isBasedOn.
usageInfo: Use for identifying recorded collision-count hotspots and data-quality issues. Do not infer causal road danger or traffic-normalized risk. No licence is assigned to this derived package because two sources show no explicit licence; credit the City of Seattle/SDOT when reusing.
measurementTechnique: Original City of Seattle/SDOT records, transformed with Tableau Prep and a Python pipeline (pipeline.py) with automated tests. Source observations were not independently verified.
